text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer, let's get right to the
experi—

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? It's you...

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm racing soon! Have you perfected the
remedy
that'll make me faster?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Our last interaction
prompted me
to do a bit of research on
you.

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um... wh-what do you mean? Why did
you need
to research me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Could you run for a bit? I just want
to make
sure I understand something
correctly.

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... An impromptu run... Is this your kind of idea to tell me you're faster than me?!

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Enough of this already! I don't care if it's

cheating, just give me th—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Have you been properly focusing on
training in
the areas you want to
improve?

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? O-of course! I'm best at end
closing, so I've
been doing training that
suits—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No. I'm pretty sure you're suited to be a
front
runner.

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You have quick reactions at the start of
a race,
and the determination to win at
any cost.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No matter how I look at it, I keep
coming to the
conclusion that you are
best suited as a front
runner.

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
B-but... before I started losing, I was
winning as
an end closer...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You sure you haven't just convinced
yourself of
that? It's better to keep your
possibilities wide
open.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I suggest you begin including front
runner training
to your regimen from
here on out. What do you
say?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fixating on your past victories will only
see you
stagnate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Like I always say, things are evolving and

changing every day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What one considers correct today might
turn out
the exact opposite tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you're not careful, you may find
yourself
affixed to obsolete knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In other words, body modification is—

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-wait... then the training I've been
pushing
myself to do until now was...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All for nothing? Is that what you were
going to
say? Don't jump to such
extreme conclusions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps your conviction is too extreme.
You
should have reevaluated your
running style
before pushing yourself so
hard.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You see, the concoction that'd make you
faster is
what is worthless. Besides, these
body
modifications are—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh... heh-heh. Couldn't have said it
better myself.
choice_data_list: It's all about chasing possibilities, isn't it?
It's all about chasing possibilities, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My concoctions are for the purpose of
gaining
knowledge, for the purpose of
discovering new
methods to gain
strength.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, don't trivialize my efforts by calling
what I do
cheating.

text_block_list.name: Curly-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah... I, uh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Here, I've already shown you your
potential!
What you do from now is up
to you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I may not have a remedy to make you
faster, but
I'll give you something better!
This will surely help
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Agnes Tachyon hands her a
clear bag
containing pills.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Well, that took up a lot of our
time, but it
was a rare and valuable
experience.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You would be interested, huh? Heh-heh.
Take a
guess.
choice_data_list: What was it you handed over earlier?
What did you hand over earlier?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh! That obvious, huh?
choice_data_list: Don't tell me... a new concoction...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I told her it was a drug that could
double the
effects of her regular
training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But actually, they're just simple
supplements. The
power of the placebo
effect is not to be
underestimated.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to give it a try, Trainer?
But of
course you would. Let's see, in
your case...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How about I give you a drink that binds
you as my
assistant for life?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Even if you don't take it, your
future is
still the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, I see the curly-haired
Umamusume
running in the lead at her
scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... Of course I have
something for
you too! It's not the same
as what I gave her
though. This here is
specially made!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon forces me to take a pill!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This concoction has the effect of making
you
devote your life to the first thing
you see!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now you can no longer escape me!
You'll live out
the rest of your days as
my assistant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's nonsense, I tell myself as I begin
preparing
to devote my entirety to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, I see the curly-haired

Umamusume running in the lead at her

scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Incidentally, it turns out those pills she
received
were just normal supplements.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's too bad I only gave her mere
supplements.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I told her it was a drug that could
double the
effects of her regular
training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You know, sometimes it's important to
have our
own convictions. That being
said...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You mentioning candy just now gives me
an
intense craving for something sweet!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking chocolate. Trainer, go buy
me some!
Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And... yes! I'll give you something to
make your
legs faster!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, she hands me a "mere
supplement,"
like what she gave the
Umamusume from earlier. I
take it, but
of course, my speed doesn't increase.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, I see the curly-haired

Umamusume running in the lead at her

scrimmage.
